text: If you wish to vex the man who hates you, do not abuse him by calling him a pathick, or effeminate, or intemperate, or a low fellow, or illiberal; but be yourself a man, and temperate, and truthful, and kind and just in all your dealings with those you come across.
author: Plutarch
locator: How a Man May Be Benefited by His Enemies, Sec. IV
